decisions.reason: The source changes only Big Block prize and trigger parameters; the independent Small Block mechanism remains unchanged.
Changing Big Block prize amounts and draw frequency does not change the manual prize-claim method.
The source does not change the automatic $5 commission for code-based referrals.
Big Block remains active, so metadata must still expose both Small Block and Big Block ticket counters.
The source changes Big Block parameters but does not alter royalty enforcement, pool funding, or ticket generation from secondary sales.
The badge rules are unrelated to the Big Block prize amount and draw trigger.
The source does not address Mauritius access restrictions; the word 'block' refers to the Big Block prize mechanism.
Changing a prize-pool parameter does not alter the requirement that public APIs, including pool-value endpoints, remain unauthenticated.
The client parameter change does not change the required deployment network.
The source does not change primary NFT mint behavior.
The dashboard must still display reward categories accurately, but its current state contains no obsolete Big Block amount or trigger attribute requiring modification.
The Big Block parameter adjustment does not change email authentication or access to dashboard prize information.
